description: This Java source file defines the GridFactory class, which provides methods to load, create, and cache grid models from XML resources for a widget system within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: GridFactory
classes.description: A utility class for creating and caching ModelGrid objects from XML resources, supporting multiple contexts such as location, webapp, and direct document parsing.

methods.name: getGridsFromLocation
methods.description: Loads all grids defined in an XML resource at a specified location.

methods.name: getGridFromLocation
methods.description: Retrieves a specific grid by name from an XML resource at a location, with caching.

methods.name: getGridFromWebappContext
methods.description: Retrieves a grid by name from a web application context, with caching.

methods.name: readGridDocument
methods.description: Parses an XML Document to extract all grid definitions and cache them.

methods.name: createModelGrid
methods.description: Creates a ModelGrid instance from an XML Document or Element, with fallback for backward compatibility.
